budgets.packing: rank-order prefix; stop at first item exceeding either budget; never slice text
budgets.token_unit: pinned BGE tokenizer tokens over serialized evidence list, excluding special tokens; not actual Qwen tokens

scoring.v4: complete required message coverage plus strict semantic correctness and cited support
scoring.public: session recall only, not complete evidence recall; strict semantic correctness and cited support judged by same Qwen model
scoring.judge: anonymous arm order by SHA256(question_id:arm), same-model comparative judge, not independent review
scoring.errors: retain all assigned questions in denominator; execution and judge errors fail
scoring.clusters: v4 pair IDs; public connected components of shared original session IDs
scoring.intervals: deterministic cluster bootstrap, seed 20261011, 10000 draws; descriptive only; few clusters
scoring.decision: no production promotion without all paired positive/negative safety cases passing, no observed supported-success loss against chat on each frozen split, source invariants and no execution errors; rerank extra p95 <=3000ms and BGE allocated GPU <=3GiB in this run; wide uncertainty and no independent human review remain blockers to production claims
